facility.name: Armand Bayou Montessori School
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 16204 HICKORY KNOLL DR, HOUSTON, TX, 77059

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: One personnel record evaluated was missing documentation to show received center and operational policies, notarized affidavit and orientation statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The operational policies are missing complete list of the parent rights documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extinguisher in the van needed to be serviced and secured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The van driver is missing two hours of transportation safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: I observe several wooden boards in the playground fence to be deteriorating and one board was missing along the rear section.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The outdoor fence for children under five years old is not four feet height requirement around the entire outdoor activity space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Outdoor Activity Space Accessible By Safe Route or get required approval of plan: I did not observe a written plan to supervise children while traveling to and from the outdoor activity space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Outdoor Activity Space Accessible By Safe Route or get required approval of plan (26 TAC §746.4311)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The day care is missing current fire marshal inspection last one expired on 01/12/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: I observe two nails protruding from wooden logs in the playground presenting safety hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Covering Infant's Head or Crib: I observe seven month  old infant that was sleeping with her head covered with small linen. Note: corrected when caregiver remove linen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Covering Infant's Head or Crib (26 TAC §746.2429)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: I did not observe current background check completed for caregiver present. Note: corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Current Driver's License: One personnel record evaluated was missing current driver license on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Two staff members are missing current transportation safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being re-cited. The loose fill surfacing on the school age playground is not measuring nine inches. Also, grass has begun to ovegrow the surfacing in areas. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, five lacked training in SIDS, Shaken Baby Syndrome, Abusive Head Trauma and Understanding Early Childhood Brain Development for the August 2020-August 2021 training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, nine lacked training in the following topics for the August 2020--August 2021 training year:  1. Emergency preparedness  2. Communicable diseases including immunizations  3. Administering medications  4. Food allergies  5. Understanding building and physical premises safety  6. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies does not inform parents of the requirement for physical activity and outside play time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director did not complete one clock hour of annual training covering SIDS, Shaken Baby Syndrome, Abusive Head Trauma and Understanding Early Childhood Brain Development for the August 2020-August 2021 training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: The operational policies does not include a Safe Sleep policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, five staff lacked current First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan does not include the following information:  1. The emergency telephone number on file with Child Care Regulation  2. How you will communicate with local authorities and Child Care Regulation  3. How staff will evacuate with parent and emergency contact information, authorization for emergency medical care and the sign-in/sign-out logs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan is lacking the following information:  1. How children under the age of 2 or children with limited mobility will be evacuated  2. The staff's responsibility in a sheltering/lock-down emergency  3. How children will be accounted for at the safe area and alternate shelter
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The van drivers and the director have not completed a valid transportation safety training course.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: The loose-fill surfacing on the school age playground is not being maintained at a depth of nine inches. Also, grass has begun to overgrow the loose-fill surfacing in some areas. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be reunited with their parents once the emergency is over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director lacked training in the following topics for the August 2020--August 2021 training year:  1. Emergency preparedness  2. Communicable diseases including immunizations  3. Administering medications  4. Food allergies  5. Understanding building and physical premises safety  6. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, five five staff lacked current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, two lacked documentation of how they meet the education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, four lacked one clock hour of training in recognizing and reporting the signs of child abuse and neglect.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))
